FLASHCARD SET · AGES 2 YEARS

Animals & Sounds flashcards.

Twenty big animal cards for toddlers who love to make some noise. Say the sound together, name the animal and then listen for it on your street, at the park or on a farm visit.

THE CARDS

Every card in the set.

Each card has its own page with the picture, the words to say and one thing to try together. Tap any card to open it.

HOW TO USE THESE CARDS

Four ways that work.

You do not need a plan or a printer schedule. Pick one idea, try it for two minutes and see what happens.

  1. 01

    Name and make the sound

    Show one card and say the animal name, then the sound: cow — moo! Let your toddler copy. Getting it "wrong" is still learning, so laugh together and try again.

  2. 02

    Play find the animal

    Lay out three or four cards and ask which one moos, or which one has wings. Let your toddler point, grab or hop on the right one — any answer that shows they looked counts.

  3. 03

    Take it outside

    After the dog card, watch for a real dog on your walk. A sound you heard on a card is twice as exciting when it walks past your garden gate.

  4. 04

    One or two cards is plenty

    Stop while it is still fun. Two minutes of animal sounds today works better than twenty minutes tomorrow.
